description: This source file contains unit tests for the WebChatSwiftUI components, including a mock transport implementation and tests for window and panel controllers using the Swift XCTest framework.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUISmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite for WebChatSwiftUI window and panel controllers, including a mock transport implementation for testing purposes.

methods.name: requestHistory(sessionKey:)
methods.description: Mocks requesting chat history, returning a predefined payload.

methods.name: sendMessage(sessionKey:message:thinking:idempotencyKey:attachments:)
methods.description: Mocks sending a message, returning a success response with a UUID.

methods.name: requestHealth(timeoutMs:)
methods.description: Mocks a health request, always returning true.

methods.name: events()
methods.description: Returns an empty asynchronous stream of transport events.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey(_:)
methods.description: Mocks setting an active session key, performs no operation.

methods.name: window controller show and close
methods.description: Test that creates a window controller, then shows and closes it.

methods.name: panel controller present and close
methods.description: Test that creates a window controller with a panel presentation, presents the panel, then closes it.
